explanation: Use symmetry to reduce k, then multiply and divide the factors of C(n-k+i,i). Every division is exact. BigInt prevents intermediate rounding before converting the advertised int-sized result.
timeComplexity: O(min(k,n-k)) arithmetic operations, with BigInt costs depending on operand bit lengths.
spaceComplexity: O(B) bits for a B-bit intermediate.
attribution: JavaScript port of the independently authored EPI Practice C# algorithm; no upstream reference code copied.
